The corner

Named after the intersection it sits on

Griffin & Wells isn't a family name. It's the crossroads out the window.

Griffin Avenue meets Wells Street in the middle of downtown Enumclaw, and the restaurant took the corner for its name. Reviewers hand it out that way too, as directions rather than an address.

It opened as Griffin & Wells Cafe, an American bistro cooking for the neighborhood. Somewhere in the last couple of years the kitchen leaned into what it did best, the sign changed to Curry House, and Enumclaw got its only Indian restaurant without losing the diner it already had.

It's women-owned, and whoever is in the building still answers reviews personally — usually a thank-you and a smiley, within the month.
